business_problem: StarKist, an established food brand in the United States focused on healthy, sustainable, shelf-stable seafood and chicken products, faced significant demand and production challenges thanks to outdated, manual processes based on spreadsheets.
solution_summary: StarKist, an established food brand in the United States focused on healthy, sustainable, shelf-stable seafood and chicken products, faced significant demand and production challenges thanks to outdated, manual processes based on spreadsheets. StarKist launched its transformation journey with Board Intelligent Planning Platform. The solution, hosted on Microsoft Azure, united StarKist’s production and planning processes with finance in a single system, providing a reliable source of truth. Cumbersome data : The StarKist supply chain department’s reliance on an SAP ERP for production planning resulted in a huge amount of data accumulating in a complex spreadsheet that became too difficult to maintain. StarKist used the Board Intelligent Planning Platform , hosted on Microsoft Azure, to effectively unite production and demand processes with finance, through a single system and source of truth.

solution_components.name: Azure Machine Learning
solution_components.role: Supports model training, experimentation, and deployment for custom machine learning workloads.

solution_components.name: Board
solution_components.role: Supports planning, forecasting, and scenario modeling on top of Azure infrastructure.

business_outcome: Increase transparency and collaboration : Moving to one shared Board solution streamlined data flows to create a single, consolidated view of StarKist’s data.
metrics: Thanks to Board, StarKist removed its reliance on spreadsheets and improved reaction time to volatile markets by reducing the planning cycle from 16 hours to less than one.
This increased agility led to a 94 percent reduction in planning time.
